changelog:
ADHD Daily Planner skill released — planning and executive function support for ADHD brains.

- Provides time-blind friendly daily planning and flexible structures with built-in pivots.
- Features realistic time estimation, dopamine-aware task design, and simple daily templates.
- Offers strategies for task initiation, working memory challenges, and decision fatigue.
- Emphasizes shame-free, ADHD-centered philosophy and practical tools for common challenges.
- Includes transition buffers, the “3 Things” system, and support for good and bad days.
